solid-bar.stealthMode.description: Toggles stealth mode, which hides direction and coordinates. If you use formatting codes on coordinates, it's recommended that you format each value separately while using this option (this is not needed on 26.2)
solid-bar.modBar.description: Customize your info! Use &code to format (minecraft.wiki/w/Formatting_codes) and {type.additional} to paste values (check them on mod page)
solid-bar.defaultRenderIndentY.descripti: Changes the Y-axis indentation in the DEFAULT renderer
solid-bar.renderIndentX.description: Changes the X-axis indentation in the other renderers (not DEFAULT)
solid-bar.renderIndentY.description: Changes the Y-axis indentation in the other renderers (not DEFAULT)
